reviews.title: Amado por Fanáticos de Comida Callejera
reviews.subtitle: Reseñas reales de antojos reales satisfechos.

items.quote: The chicken biryani tasted like it came straight from a Hyderabad street cart. Arrived in 28 minutes, still steaming.
items.name: Priya Nair

items.quote: Their seekh kebab roll is unreal. Smoky, spicy, perfectly wrapped. I order it every Friday night.
items.name: Marcus Chen

items.quote: Pani puri delivered without going soggy? Saffron Street actually figured it out. Genuinely impressed.
items.name: Ananya Rao

items.quote: Ordered the mutton biryani for a family dinner, it was gone in minutes. Rich, smoky, perfectly spiced.
items.name: David Okafor

items.quote: Fast delivery, hot food, and the chaat tastes exactly like back home. This is my go-to cloud kitchen now.
items.name: Simran Kaur

items.quote: The rose falooda is the perfect finish after a spicy roll. Thirty minutes, every single time.
items.name: Leo Fernandes
